$schema_note: openclaw bundled-plugin manifest — declares the memex MCP HTTP server, its skills, and the openclaw plugin-API compat range. Loaded by openclaw / clawhub at startup.
name: memex
description: Personal-knowledge brain with PGLite + pgvector hybrid search, Bedrock Titan v2 embeddings, AWS-native (no external API keys).

vault_paths.description: Filesystem paths the legacy sweep recipe may scan (e.g. /memory for openclaw session history). The DB-canonical redesign treats memex's Postgres store as the source of truth; this option will move to a per-recipe config in a future release.

bedrock_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock Titan v2 embedding calls. Credentials come from the EC2 IAM role + AWS_PROFILE=default — no static keys.

mcp_rate_limit_per_minute.description: Token-bucket cap on POST /mcp requests per source IP.

memex.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP transport over HTTP — initialize, tools/list, tools/call. Reachable on the docker-internal network from the openclaw container; not exposed publicly.
